scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.14 changes shared Electron sync convergence and Readwise API import behavior used by the macOS desktop app, so the macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.14 changes Windows-facing sync provider labels and shared multi-device convergence behavior, so the Windows package and direct installer are required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.14 changes shared Electron sync and Readwise behavior used by Linux Experimental, so the Linux Experimental package is required.
